dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped high-contrast rings are visible across the central dorsal-lateral area. The perimeters exhibit sharp pixel-intensity gradients from dark outer edges to lighter centers, with particularly jagged and serrated geometries on the larger rings located mid-body.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Concentrated clusters of high-intensity white pixels are present, particularly where annuli intersect or overlap. Density is highest in the mid-section, transitioning to lower density and smaller blob sizes towards the anterior and posterior extremities.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A series of three prominent macro-annuli in the mid-left quadrant form a nearly equilateral triangular relationship. Further posterior, a secondary set of centroids forms a wider, obtuse-angled polygon spanning the lateral width.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive lattice-like pattern where multiple annuli appear to merge or touch, creating a honeycomb-like high-contrast topology in the lower-central region.
